listing.name: Tails Adventure Remake
listing.summary: Play the Tails Adventure remake while keeping your saved progress, settings and mods.

steps.title: Keep the complete portable player
steps.instruction: The inspected Windows ZIP contains tails-adventure.exe and its assets tree; no original ROM, BIOS, first-run extraction or compilation is required by this route. Keep matching assets/default_config and packaged resources.

steps.title: Keep your saves, options and mods
steps.instruction: The Windows player stores both options and saved progress in config beside the executable. Supported mods live in mods/ beside it. Keep both with their creating runtime and close the game normally before maintenance: the inspected title writes config during shutdown. Put replacement content in the supported mods tree; direct edits to shipped assets are outside the declared preserved data and can block update or removal until preserved and reconciled. Runtime rollback retains current data and does not rewind saves or guarantee cross-version mod/save compatibility.

warnings: Upstream reports missing nonessential original features; completion/gameplay claims belong to upstream and have not been repeated here. Preserve a separate copy before changing mods or data.

presentation.manual_preparation: No original ROM or BIOS selection is required by the inspected Windows package. Keep its complete assets tree. Portcove preserves config (combined options and saves) and supported mods/ through accepted compatible runtime maintenance; direct edits to runtime assets and external copies remain outside that data contract. Close the actual game normally before backup or replacement. Runtime rollback keeps current data and does not rewind saved progress.
